_about: What each designed site looks like, for scripts/check-fingerprints.mjs (Tzvi, 19 Oct 2026: businesses must not come out too similar). Fonts and colours are read from the pages; these six are written by hand when a site is built. own_colours: colours taken from the business's own logo or menu, which never count as a clash.

chicken-munch.hero: giant word with their real product cut out and dropped across it
chicken-munch.signature: letters spread and the product rises on scroll; stickers with real facts
chicken-munch.nav: dark bar, wordmark, pages, outline order button
chicken-munch.close: dark band with contacts and a giant two-colour wordmark

whipped-cup.hero: their sunniest real photo full screen, headline over the shaded side
whipped-cup.signature: pinned scroll: a drawn glass fills with ice, milk, then the whipped cloud, following their own three steps
whipped-cup.nav: light frosted bar, round monogram badge, pages, outline order button
whipped-cup.close: chocolate band with a giant serif name
whipped-cup.layout: multi-page: home, menu, order, contact; packages as a tiered bento
whipped-cup.ground: blush cream with chocolate and pink

elisheva-nails.hero: arched frame of their real work beside the headline
elisheva-nails.signature: tap a polish shade: their photo in that colour opens from the chip and the whole opening takes the shade
elisheva-nails.nav: light bar, monogram logo, spaced capitals, pages, outline book button
elisheva-nails.close: deep rose band with a giant script name
elisheva-nails.layout: multi-page: home, book, contact; services as a priced list
